title: Amazon ECS blue/green deployments with Amazon VPC Lattice
description: Amazon ECS Fargate blue/green with Amazon VPC Lattice test and production listener rules, an AWS Lambda test hook and an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for rollback.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon ECS Fargate service that uses the built-in blue/green deployment strategy with Amazon VPC Lattice. The VPC Lattice service has a listener with a test rule (header x-environment: test) and a production rule, and two IP target groups that ECS registers tasks into.

When you deploy a new version, ECS starts the green tasks and sends test traffic to them. An AWS Lambda lifecycle hook in the VPC calls the VPC Lattice test rule, compares the version it receives with the expected one and returns SUCCEEDED or FAILED. Only then does ECS shift production traffic. An Amazon CloudWatch alarm on VPC Lattice 5xx responses rolls the deployment back automatically.

ECS blue/green with a Lambda hook and a test listener is already shown with an Application Load Balancer. What is new here is the VPC Lattice wiring: listener rules, target groups, the ECS infrastructure role and in-VPC reachability for the hook.

text: Read the stack outputs, then deploy a second version with npx cdk deploy -c appVersion=v2.

Watch the deployment with aws ecs list-service-deployments and aws ecs describe-service-deployments, the production listener rule weights with aws vpc-lattice get-rule, and the hook Lambda logs with aws logs filter-log-events. The hook log shows the test listener returning the new version before production traffic shifts.
